families.name: From a certificate to a profile
From cell data to the certificate

meaning: Each tie is a pointer that landed. Whether the paper and the Lean say the same thing is a reading.

rows.fidelity_note: The profile premise has the stated smoothness, nontriviality, orthogonal recurrence and first two decay bounds. It additionally requires second spatial derivative and pressure-gradient decay.

rows.fidelity_note: At terminal time one and phase s₀=0, the physical field is (1−t)⁻¹/²W(−log(1−t),x/√(1−t)), exactly u₁*.

rows.fidelity_note: From one compact solenoidal datum with no uniformly finite-energy global smooth solution at viscosity one, the scaling result supplies such data for every positive viscosity. This linked result concerns the whole-space endpoint.
